SHORT right end with single handle nearest camera. Four circular sorting cavities remain exactly 2x2, long front scoop edge-on at image-left. Keep exact material, finish, weave, dimensions, bindings, handles, cavities and natural resting/display pose of the reference. Match sensible elevation, warm-white seamless background, soft light, scale and framing. Whole object centered with margins. No three-quarter azimuth, mirroring, detached objects, props, people, food, animals or plants. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, letters, numbers, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermark or measurements.
